name: Heroine Zen'in Osaifu Nerai! ~Okane o Kaseide Onna no Ko ni Mitsugu Papakatsu SLG~
original_name: ヒロイン全員お財布狙い!～お金を稼いで女の子に貢ぐパパ活SLG～
source:
Financial Domination Simulator

This is a simulator type of game with the theme of "being financially exploited by girls".
Being totally into "financial support for girls", you earn and throw money into it.
There are six girls who you are going to give financial aid.
Depending on the amount of money you have given, love meter and the amount of money at your hand, H events will happen.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ236146.html]DLsite English[/url]]
